repo_notes.content: Phantom (@ashlr/phantom) is a TypeScript (Node >=22.15, ESM) engineering agent workbench. The CLI ships as `phm` with `ashlr` as a compatible alias. Layout: src/cli/ holds thin command dispatchers, src/core/ holds all logic, src/web-ui/ is the console, test/ holds hermetic backend suites, docs/ holds guides indexed by docs/README.md. Prefer diagrams for data flow between the daemon, fleet queue, lanes and the web console. Link claims to source files.

Agent authority is defined in AGENTS.md and CONSTITUTION.md; describe what agents may do versus what is reserved for the owner. Never document secret values, tokens or real home-directory paths; secrets are referenced by name only.
